story.headline: Police Seek Suspects in Blackmail Case
story.dek: Hector Reyes, 48, is sought for blackmailing a player with photographs
body: Police are looking for Hector Reyes, 48, a groundskeeper, in connection with blackmailing a player with photographs at the Lamplighters game.
Officers found a telephoto camera and eleven photographs in a vehicle registered to Reyes. Police said the plan did not work.
Neighbors described Reyes as quiet. Reyes has one prior arrest, in 1987, for a similar matter.
"We want to know who paid for it," said Keiko Gibson of the Haldane Organization. The Commissioner's Office said it was "aware of the matter."
The Lamplighters play again tomorrow. The club said security will be increased.
